name: Safe Pass Practice Test
fullName: SOLAS Safe Pass construction health and safety awareness (Ireland)
notes: Categories follow the 13 learning units of the one-day Safe Pass Tutor Led Programme (constructioncourses.ie): 1-2 law, 3 accident reporting, 4 and 8 risk assessment and behaviour-based safety, 5 electricity, 6 excavations, 7 heights, 9-10 equipment and vehicles, 11-12 health, welfare, noise and vibration, 13 PPE. SOLAS publishes no weights or question count for the course's tutor-read multiple-choice assessment; the alternative renewal computer test is 50 questions in 45 minutes, 45 correct to pass. Four 50-question mock tests at 90% (45 of 50) mirror that renewal test. Pools are exactly 4x per-test counts. Content sets, so sets first, then tests.
